newsitem.title: UK: BAA launches World Duty Free business.
newsitem.headline: BAA launches World Duty Free business.

text.p: BAA Plc said it has established a tax free retail business called World Duty Free, to take over a number of contracts at British airports curently held by Nuance, formerly Allders International.
It was announced last week that the contracts for Nuance to handle duty free at Heathrow terminal 2, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Aberdeen, Stansted aand Southampton airports will end in the spring of 1997.
BAA said it currently has a five percent share of the $20 billion world market for duty and tax free retailing, of which the leader DFS has 14 percent.
BAA's plans for World Duty Free include the opening of Studio 55, the first airport shop in the world for Japanese travellers.
